_about: Test discount codes for checkout.html (brief §3.7a, §4.18, B41). One code per order; a code never stacks with the launch price — the better of the two applies and the discount row names which. Codes are matched case-insensitively after trimming. type: percent (value = % off the everyday subtotal, rounded to the penny) or fixed (value = £ off, capped at the subtotal). minSubtotal (everyday £) is optional. Owner: P7.
